components.name: Filter Button
components.description: Compact row control for toggling an Atlas filter.
components.css: .ds-filter-button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; color: #b0a8c8; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; font: 12px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-filter-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffb74d; } .ds-filter-button:hover { background: #1e1e3a; border-color: #4a3f6b; } .ds-filter-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c4dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Filter Button
components.description: Selected filter state with violet containment.
components.css: .ds-filter-button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; color: #e0d9f0; background: #1e1e3a; border: 1px solid #7c4dff; border-radius: 5px; font: 12px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ce93d8; } .ds-filter-button:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-filter-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8a96e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-tooltip { width: 280px; overflow: hidden; color: #e0d9f0; background: #1a1a2e; border: 1px solid #4a3f6b; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); font: 13px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tooltip-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 12px 8px; background: #16213e; border-bottom: 1px solid #4a3f6b; } .ds-tooltip strong { display: block; color: #c8a96e; font-size: 14px; } .ds-tooltip-header span, .ds-label { display: block; color: #888; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .5px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tooltip button { padding: 0 2px; color: #888; background: transparent; border: 0; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tooltip button:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-tooltip button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8a96e; } .ds-tooltip-body { padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }

components.name: Atlas Legend Chip
components.css: .ds-legend-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #b0a8c8; background: rgba(13,13,26,.85); border: 1px solid #2a2a4a; border-radius: 4px; font: 11px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-legend-chip i { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #ef9a9a; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Atlas Map Node
components.description: Semantic map point with layered rings for filter, preference, and selection state.
components.css: .ds-map-node { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 48px; padding: 0; color: #c8c8e8; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font: 9px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-map-ring, .ds-map-core { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-map-ring--filter { width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 2px solid #4fc3f7; opacity: .85; } .ds-map-ring--preferred { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2px solid #c8a96e; } .ds-map-core { width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #3a3a5c; border: 1px solid #6a6a9a; } .ds-map-node small { position: absolute; top: 32px; } .ds-map-node:hover .ds-map-core { filter: brightness(1.6); } .ds-map-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview: This is a dark, map-first working environment for reading a dense Atlas without competing with it. Near-black indigo gives the canvas a quiet night-sky field; layered panels and thin violet borders separate tools from terrain. Gold appears sparingly as a durable marker of preference and identity, while high-chroma filter colors are reserved for the data states that need to survive a crowded map.
keyCharacteristics: Dark indigo canvas with compact layered control surfaces.
Sparse antique-gold emphasis for title, preference, and selected-map identity.
Bright filter colors used as functional wayfinding, never general decoration.
Fine violet borders and small radii for restrained spatial structure.

rules.name: The Gold Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Reserve gold for the product identity and persistent player preference. Do not use it as a generic primary-button or hover color.

rules.name: The Atlas Stays Loudest Rule
rules.body: Keep UI type compact and subordinate to map geometry. Avoid oversized headlines, marketing scale, or expressive display typography.

rules.name: The One Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary controls and panels flat. Use the tooltip shadow only when a surface must interrupt the map for focused reading.

dos: Do use Midnight Field and layered indigo surfaces to keep the Atlas visually dominant.
Do reserve the signal spectrum for filters, matching node rings and legend swatches exactly.
Do use Gold for the title and persisted preference states.
Do keep controls concise, row-based, and visibly connected to the Atlas data they affect.
Do use the 8px tooltip radius and Tooltip Lift when presenting selected-map details.
donts: Don't introduce bright general-purpose buttons, broad gradients, or large decorative artwork into the working canvas.
Don't use Gold as a default accent for unrelated controls or transient hover states.
Don't replace thin violet borders with heavy dividers or prominent card shadows.
Don't expand the interface into spacious dashboard cards that reduce available Atlas territory.
